selected_protocol.name: Fresh-Blind Hybrid with External-First Source Hierarchy
core_flow: historical DEV + historical VALIDATION => one exposed 7-group adaptive development/selection pool
prospective group-aware paired comparison and sensitivity analysis on exposed pool
fresh blind real-domain measurement using Tier A partner-held source when operationally available
Tier B independently authored and independently adjudicated hidden real-domain source when Tier A is unavailable

candidate_freeze.blind_feedback_reuse_rule: If blind results are viewed and a later candidate is created, a new independent blind source/generation is required for an independent generalization claim.

requirements: hidden case semantics and expected outcomes unavailable before candidate freeze
domain/risk coverage consistent with final claims
case author insulated from current candidate behavior
independent adjudication of expected outcomes/reference supervision
hidden semantics unavailable to developer before freeze

reversal_triggers.condition: Tier A lacks named source owner/custodian, blind-custody rule, expected delivery window, or no-adaptive-feedback confirmation.
reversal_triggers.action: Move B4 planning to Tier B.

reversal_triggers.condition: Neither Tier A nor Tier B has an auditable feasible hidden real-domain source path.
reversal_triggers.action: Require explicit BIG-B3 amendment before activating degraded P3; do not silently weaken P12.

reversal_triggers.condition: Explicit amendment activates P3 because no fresh blind source is feasible.
reversal_triggers.action: Downgrade final claim to qualified benchmark performance under a structurally exposed legacy final set; no strong independent production-domain generalization claim.

reversal_triggers.condition: Semantic leak, iterative partial feedback, hidden-label access, or pre-freeze adaptation to candidate outputs occurs.
reversal_triggers.action: Reclassify source as exposed; require new independent blind source/generation.

reversal_triggers.condition: Material evaluator/judge change is made in response to blind outcomes.
reversal_triggers.action: Consume blind measurement for that evaluation-stack generation; require new final source for fresh independent claim.

rejected_as_default.reason: Dominated by P1/P2 on independence and evidential strength; retained only as explicit degraded contingency.
Unnecessarily brittle to external availability despite P2 being architecturally compatible and non-dominated.
Would discard stronger organizational blindness from P1 before availability is tested.
Cannot retroactively nest historical human adaptive engineering.
